testcase.name: Scenario: Open ribbon customization from the Tools tab in its first captured state: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:136:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open ribbon customization from the Tools tab in its first captured state ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Tools ribbon tab is selected ✔ And ribbon customization has not been opened earlier in the captured session ✔ When the user clicks "Customize" in the Options panel ✔ Then the customization dialog opens on the "Ribbon" tab ✔ And the target selector shows "Part | Tools" ✔ And the available-command category is "All Commands" ✔ And the Part | Tools custom panel list is empty with no pending-change marker ✔ And Close is available while Cancel and Apply are unavailable ✔ When the user clicks "Close" ✔ Then the dialog closes and the Tools ribbon remains visible
